description: Details for one product, by slug (from search_catalog) or by any of its variant SKUs: description, colors with images and availability, sizes, the size chart (garment measurements), fabric specs, and how well it takes each decoration method (screen print, DTG, embroidery, sublimation, heat-transfer vinyl, discharge, DTF). Pass `color` to also get that color's sizes, each with its SKU and availability.

color.description: A color name exactly as listed in `colors`.

sku.description: A variant SKU from get_product (called with a color).

name: get_product
title: Get product details
